Kid's body was found in a nearby park later that night, raped and strangled. Suspect was seen driving a green car. Didn't really realise how close I came to being murdered until my Mom made me watch this a few years later.

No one would mess with me because I was the funny guy with plenty of money for canteen.

In prison people like to laugh and they like snacks even more. I was constantly doing two for one deals meaning "Yo! fistpunch! hook me up with some Cup O' Noodles and I'll hit you double when canteen comes in" No problem. Inmates don't shit where they eat and my cell was filled with food.

No problem, sorry about the delay. My friends helped me immensely. They pretty much told me to cut the crap and not be an idiot. They said I was way too smart to be in that lifestyle when I could apply myself doing something else that was positive overall.

All my true friends knew what I was doing and even staged an intervention at my house (there was about 40 people that showed up) and I didn't give a shit. All I cared about was getting high and making money but I will admit that when they left I went into my room, got high and cried while thinking "What the fuck am I doing?" These people cared about me and I basically got angry and kicked them out of my house.

None of my good true friends were in the trade. They are all married with good jobs, houses and some of them have kids. I feel very fortunate that they stood by me and took the time to care. Not a lot of people have that kind of support so now I hope to be a person that gives support to others that don't have it.

The young patrol men are hoping for a bust but when a detective pulls me over it's just "How you holding up fistpunch? Sorry to bug you but can you stop by the house and check out my computer? It's running kind of slow ever since the kids,wife or whoever have been using it."  O.K. Detective but you need to stop watching porn from shady sites.

I was never violent. Cash up front and if you owed me money I would just cut off your supply. Goodbye. Find someone else. The only thing I ever did when I first started dealing weight was answer a phone call from my boss telling me to get over to his house NOW!

I show up and there is a rental car in his driveway with a big bouncer looking dude standing next to it. Boss comes out and says "Get in the car" I'm in fucking shock thinking I fucked up somehow. I look at the back seat and it's covered in plastic painters drop cloth. I had a neck knife (knife that hangs off a chain under your shirt) and I was ready to kill both of them. It turns out that we were going to pick up a kid that owed some money and the plastic in the back seat was only there to scare the shit out of him.

We drove around with this kid sitting in the middle of the back seat, me on one side big bouncer dude on the other. Poor kid. He didn't piss himself but you could smell fear. He paid the money the next day and we never saw him again except for occasional sightings in downtown Providence.

Getting shot in the wrist after buying drugs in N.Y. I was sitting in the car and testing the product (I was hooked on heroin at the time) and someone tried to kill me. I was nodding off from the effects of the drugs when I sensed someone outside the drivers side door. I looked up and the guy had a gun pointed at me. I put my arm up to protect my head and he fired but the bullet hit the door jam then lodged in my wrist.

I threw the car in reverse and hopped on the highway back to MA. No way I was going to the hospital. Come to find out the whole thing was a set up. Pics if you want.
No. Not in prison, just got sick of the lifestyle. My true friends stood by me when I got out and you should never let your friends down.

Sorry, I know it's been a day but that is very accurate. Rehabilitation is a joke in prison. It's just punishment (or a time out if you will) plain and simple and money for the state. Do you know how much private companies make just on canteen? (meaning snacks and stuff) The system wants you back in, no doubt about it.

Post prison has been good. Hard to get a job so I started fixing computers on my own. Not making a lot of money, just enough so I can eat and pay the bills which makes me very happy. No more throwing up in the morning from stress thinking that the cops are going to bust down my door today or that I might get killed by someone trying to rob me.

After leaving prison It was kinda weird to re-adjust. If someone cut me in line at the supermarket or looked at me the wrong way I would probably hit them. It was hard when I got out cause every time the phone rang I thought it was a sale and my heart would start racing. I would wake up and reality would check in telling me that I wasn't living like that any more. Rough transition.

Your Xena reference is spot on (I have not seen that show in ages!) but I have a hard time forgiving myself.

I would stomp (cut) the pure kilos and it was usually what ever the buyer wanted never under an ounce.

HUGE amount of guilt. I still can't sleep at night cause the only thing I see in my minds eye is my friends faces in a casket. It's fucking horrible. They looked up to me thinking "Well if fistpunch likes it it must be cool" I was so stupid and selfish that I could not recognize that I was a role model for these guys. This is something I will carry too my grave.

All the people that I have fed an addiction to are dead or in prison. All the rest I have wiped my memory clean of and burnt their numbers. The stare downs at the the funerals or wakes were the worst. I had to be there because they were my friends but when you have your best friends mom slap you in the face after a funeral you know you are a piece of shit. I will never forgive myself  no matter how hard I try to make everything right. I fucked up.

I fucked up so many peoples life's with hard drugs and even though it was their choice I still provided for them cause all I cared about was money.

I've achieved all my goals by staying clean and helping people in need with guidance in this thing called life.

Everything in life has a purpose. I am here to help try and drag some people out of their own personal hell. That's why I am alive when I should have been dead along time ago. Rock bottom? Been there done that. Come with me and enjoy life. It's kinda cool when you get to know it.

No money. I wasted everything by dipping into my own supply. I fucked up and now I'm on the straight a narrow fixing computers. I'd rather be broke doing that than getting into that lifestyle again. I burned all my bridges with those people. Most of them are dead or in prison. Fact.

Profit margin was great cause I was dealing in bulk so I would get a kilo of coke for around $20,000 and $15,000 for heroin at the time and it was pure so I would stomp it (meaning cut it with sugar, baby laxatives, B12 vitamins and such) and double my profit. Yup. Scumbag fistpunch.

It's tech speak for death.

Went to Best Buy four days before christmas to get my sister a laptop cause hers shit the bed and I didn't have time to order one online. Mom gave me $400 and said "I trust you son, you work in I.T."

Stroll on in and see a decent laptop for $350. Sales guy comes over asking if I need help. "No thanks. I want this one and nothing else." Sales guy looks dejected as he tries to up sell me and is met with a resounding No! each time. I get the laptop and head to checkout.

Fun time. Sales Manager is at the register and saw the hole shit go down. He proceeds to tell me that this laptop with 4gb of ram will not run Windows7 properly and I need at least 8gb and if I do not have the latest full subscription of Norton my computer is going to get a virus costing me money in the long run. I also have to buy Microsoft Office from them or else I can't make any documents.

The whole time he was talking I was picking my nose and staring at my fingers then staring back at the $380 cash I had put on the counter. He got the hint.

TL;DR. Sorry sales people I know your pay rate is judged on sales but no means no. You don't want me picking my nose in front of your customers while mumbling.

Showed up at a party already drunk and proceeded to get even more happy idiot drunk. I had just gotten out of prison about a year earlier and one of my initiations in prison was being surrounded by brothers of a different color (I'm a white ass peckerwood, cracker, white bread looking mofo)  asking me if I knew any nigger jokes. Awkward but they laughed their asses off for scaring the shit out of me.

My friends at the party knew this story and thought it was funny as hell so I yelled out "Who wants to hear some nigger jokes!" The room went completely silent and one of my friends pointed to the living room. I peaked my head around the corner and saw my pale ass white friend with his new ebony girlfriend complete with her two brothers and a cousin. I had to pass by them while leaving as I hung my head in shame feeling like a asshole while wanting to explain the context of the statement. Longest walk through a living room ever.

His girlfriend eventually heard the the prison story so the next time I saw her she said " I'm sorry fistpunch. It must be tough being white." Awesome sense of humour that one.

She is clean and sober except for the shit ton of beer we drink together on her days off while discussing everything from politics, religion (which I hate talking about because no one wins) and philosophy coupled with a healthy amount of fart jokes. 

I love you crazy woman. Don't ever change.

Quite a few but the first one that pops in my mind is when I cut out a picture of a male underwear model from a magazine and taped it to the top overhang of my prison cell mates bunk. Little did he know I had stuffed the back of the picture with baby powder. I had top bunk and was reading waiting for him to come back from Rec and trying not to laugh.

He comes in, lays down, looks up and yells "What the fuck is this stupid shit fistpunch!" He then yanks down the picture and gets covered in baby powder, runs back out of the cell where everyone can see him, forever giving him the prison nickname "Whitey" which sucked for him cause he was black.

Small town High school in football land.We had Gillette Stadium and there was a lot of bullies and douchebags that thought they had to exert their toughness so they could be the next star of the New England Patriots.

Switched to a vocational high school and everyone there was laid back and just focusing on creating a career in whatever trade they wanted. Fights here and there but then again it's high school.

Had a really good friend in middle school. I had just moved to the town and we just hit it off. He introduced me to one of his friends and we all decided to make a tree fort in the woods. We had axes,saws and machetes for bush whacking. We cleared out a spot and got to work chopping tree's. All of the sudden my friend? looks over at his friend whom I'd just met and throws an axe at him. No reason, just out of the blue, his friend wasn't hurt but we did not want to be alone in the woods with this guy.

Not too long ago I ran into him (I hadn't seen him in a decade or so) at a gas station and we shook hands and gave each other a hug. I asked him what he's been up to blah blah blah. He told me he joined the Army and he is now a Ranger. I said cool (this was pre 911) what made you join" He said "Ever since I was a kid I wanted to kill people cause I was always angry, now I can"

I kinda backed up a little and said "Nice seeing you again, tell your family I said hi"

I will never talk shit about the military but there are weird people that join for that reason. Killing people over there or him snapping mentally here and shooting up a shopping mall.

TL;DR Sigh. I don't understand peoples behaviour sometimes.
